result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other purchase-order reports.

- **Fix:** In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6514), the subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and latest-purchase-order queries use.
- **Test:** I added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` to `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`. It sets up your example (Anna in the North, Bob in the South, one received and one sent North order, one sent and two cancelled South orders) and expects `Anna:2`, `Bob:1`. I also gave the test's helper method a status parameter so the new test can create cancelled orders.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` runs 4 tests, all passing. Nothing is committed.
